content:
Applications open until 14 May.

The BIM Excellence Award aims to value and promote digitalisation and the implementation of BIM at national level, through the dissemination and promotion of good practices, especially those resulting from existing standards.

In this way it contributes to the dissemination of BIM and digital construction in the public and private sectors, through the sharing of success stories and the identification of the various advantages involved.

It also aims to encourage the structuring of information and the creation of BIM libraries for national products, promote the adoption of the BIM methodology and construction digitalisation practices, in order to increase the competitiveness of the AEC sector internationally, where BIM is already widespread.

The BIM Excellence Award was created by CT197-BIM, the National BIM Standardisation Technical Committee, made up of dozens of voluntary experts who contribute to BIM standardisation. In 2021, BUILT CoLAB, the AEC Cluster and PTPC – the Portuguese Construction Technology Platform, joined this initiative, with the aim of promoting good practices and raising awareness among industry and public administration of the need for digital transition in construction.

Applications ran from 12 April to 14 May, and the finalists were announced on 31 May 2021.

The winners were announced on 28 July. Find out here who the winners were and watch the videos here of the projects recognised by the jury.

Organisation and Support

This award is an initiative of CT197-BIM, with the support of BUILT CoLAB, the AEC Cluster and PTPC. These entities share the cross-cutting mission of promoting good practices in the construction industry, highlighting the importance of innovation and digitalisation of the industry and the built environment, promoting the digital and climate transition of buildings and infrastructure, making them adaptable, intelligent, resilient and sustainable.

Regulations

Categories you can apply for

The BIM Excellence Award will distinguish three categories:
• Simulation and Design;
• Planning and Construction;
• Built Environment Management – Buildings and Infrastructure.

Eligibility Criteria

The following entities are eligible:

• Category “Simulation and Design”:
– Companies that have implemented BIM in their specialty (architecture, structures, HVAC, electrical systems, building services, etc.), in their organisation or in a specific project, with an integrated and collaborative vision of the project being valued, particularly if based on standardised working methods;
– Entities that have developed advanced BIM simulations and optimisations as part of BIM projects;
– Entities that have coordinated integrated BIM projects, involving various specialties and skills.
• Category “Planning and Construction”:
– Entities that have planned and managed construction with digital support, using innovative tools and methodologies;
– Construction companies that have implemented BIM in their construction activities, valuing an integrated and collaborative vision of the development, particularly if based on standardised working methods;
– Entities that have coordinated integrated BIM developments, including design and construction.
• Category “Built Environment Management – Buildings and Infrastructure”:
– entities that have implemented BIM and applied it to asset management, for example through the use of the Digital Twin concept, using, for example, sensor systems and/or KPIs;
– entities that apply digital technologies to the management and maintenance of buildings and infrastructure.

• In any of the categories, the participant must be based in national territory, but may present international experience, in which the candidate must demonstrate a leading role;
• The initiatives/projects presented may still be ongoing or must have been completed in the year prior to this edition.

Important Dates

• Application submission period: 12 April 2021 to 14 May 2021;
• Announcement of finalists: 31 May 2021;
• Submission period for presentation videos: 1 June to 30 June 2021;
• Awards ceremony: July, on a date to be determined.

General conditions

Participation in the BIM Excellence Award requires that:

• Candidates are based in Portugal;
• Candidates authorise the free use and disclosure of all submitted information, their name and image;
• Candidates have authorisation from the authors of the projects to disclose the submitted material;
• Candidates agree to all the clauses of these regulations.

Jury

The Jury for the BIM Excellence Award 2021 will be made up of the following members:

  • BUILT CoLAB: Professor António Aguiar Costa (Chair of the Jury)
  • AEC Cluster/Portuguese Construction Technology Platform (PTPC): Eng. Rita Moura
  • Faculdade de Engenharia da Universidade do Porto (FEUP): Prof. João Poças Martins
  • Instituto Superior Técnico, Universidade de Lisboa: Prof. Francisco Teixeira Bastos
  • Laboratório Nacional de Engenharia Civil: Eng. Paula Couto
  • Ordem dos Arquitetos: Arq. Claudia Antunes
  • Ordem dos Engenheiros: Prof. Fernando Pinho
  • Universidade do Minho: Prof. Miguel Azenha

     International Guests:

  • Universidade de São Paulo: Prof. Eduardo Toledo Santos
  • University of Bath: Prof. Ricardo Codinhoto

The Chair of the Jury will have the casting vote in the event of a tie.

Assessment Stages

i) Validation of entries: verification that the Entry Form (Annex A) has been completed. Registered participants will be informed of the formal compliance of their entry within 48 hours;
ii) Selection of finalists: the BIM Excellence Award jury will assess which applications will proceed to the next stage, based on the form submitted by the candidate and taking into account the assessment criteria presented in Annex B;
iii) Final presentation of finalists: finalist participants must produce a video lasting no more than 5 minutes, in which they may have to answer specific questions identified by the Jury;
iv) Selection of Winners: based on the initial documentation and the video developed by the candidates, the Jury will select the Winner and the Honourable Mention (which may or may not exist depending on the quality of the proposals) for each category;
iv) Announcement of winners: after the jury has selected the winning candidates within each category, these will be announced at the awards ceremony.

Conditions for Submitting an Application

• Candidates may enter more than one category;
• For future purposes, projects that have won in previous editions in the same category may not enter;
• Whenever there is a potential “conflict of interest” between professionals, companies or institutions applying and one or more members of the jury, those members of the jury will not take part in the voting;
• Entries must be made exclusively online, on the BUILT CoLAB website, by fully completing the Entry Form for the respective category.

Award

The finalists of the BIM Excellence Award will be announced on the BUILT CoLAB website and will be entitled to:
• A Trophy for Winners;
• An Award Certificate;
• A digital Award seal for publication on digital channels;
• Wide-ranging publicity.

Contacts

If you have any further questions, please contact the organisation by e-mail at info@builtcolab.pt.
